VideoProject.title: VideoProject
VideoProject.description: A long-form AI video production project owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated project owner.

title.description: Project title in Arabic or English.

synopsis.description: Full script synopsis or story prompt.

genre.description: Cinematic genre of the video project.

targetDurationSeconds.description: Total target duration of the long video in seconds.

sceneCount.description: Number of scenes in this project.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of project creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VideoScene.title: VideoScene
VideoScene.description: An individual scene within a long-form AI video project, including camera motion, Arabic narration, and 3-point PBR studio lighting controls.

sceneIndex.description: Zero-based sequential index of the scene in the timeline.

narrationAr.description: Arabic voiceover narration and subtitle script for this scene.

visualPrompt.description: Detailed photorealistic prompt used to synthesize and light the scene frame.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of this scene in seconds (3 to 60s).

cameraMovement.description: Cinematic camera movement applied during video rendering.

transitionType.description: Transition effect to the next scene.

lightAngleDeg.description: Directional key light azimuth angle in degrees (0-360).

lightElevationDeg.description: Key light elevation angle in degrees (0-90).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

GeneratedVideo.title: GeneratedVideo
GeneratedVideo.description: A compiled and exported MP4 video record saved by an authenticated user for the Projects Gallery.

title.description: Display title of the exported video.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio of the exported video.

thumbnailBase64.description: Compact Base64 JPEG thumbnail preview for gallery display.

localFilePath.description: Device file path of the exported MP4 video.

videoUrl.description: Optional backend or cloud streaming URL for the generated MP4 video.

mediaMimeType.description: MIME type of the generated media (e.g. video/mp4).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of export creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: User-scoped long-form AI video production projects.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/sce.description: Ordered timeline scenes belonging to a specific video project.

/users/{userId}/generated_videos/{videoI.description: Exported final MP4 video entries with thumbnails and timestamps for Projects Gallery.
